_comment: Groups MITRE tactics into the four narrative sections of the report. Purely organizational — changing which tactic belongs to which narrative group never touches the MITRE mapping data or the engine logic. TA0112 (Defense Impairment) is grouped with C for narrative continuity with what was formerly the single Defense Evasion tactic before MITRE ATT&CK v19 split it into Stealth (TA0005) and Defense Impairment (TA0112) — see mitre-mapping.json's top comment.
